title: Canonical coefficient comparisons preserve the derived adjunction
statement: Let Λ and Λ′ be commutative rings in Type(u+1), φ:Λ→Λ′ a ring homomorphism, and f:Z→W any morphism of schemes. Let Res_Z and Res_W denote the exact restriction functors on bounded below derived categories, and U_f, V_f the canonical inverse- and direct-image comparisons of [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. For every M in D⁺(W_et,Λ′), the unit η_f at Res_W(M), followed by Rf_*(U_f(M)) and V_f(f^*M)^{-1}, equals Res_W(η′_f(M)). For every N in D⁺(Z_et,Λ′), f^*(V_f(N)^{-1}), followed by U_f(Rf′_*N) and Res_Z(ε′_f(N)), equals ε_f(Res_Z(N)). These are the unit and counit of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction used in [sbc-def-base-change-map]; no square or base-change map occurs in either identity.

proof.text: Identify the underived mate of upperStarRestrictScalarsIso with the sectionwise identity lowerStarRestrictScalarsIso. Apply the injective mates equivalence for restriction/coextension to both sides. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv identifies the double mate on the inverse-image side with conjugation under the composite adjunctions. By the definition of leftAdjointUniq this is conjugateEquiv applied to its inverse on the identity, hence the identity. On the direct-image side, evaluate on a sheaf and an etale section: the double mate is exactly ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.right_triangle_components. Thus the two underived squares are mates.

Compute the exact derived inverse-image square on bounded below homotopy complexes. Expand its definition as the inverse exact-functor composition isomorphism, mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso of the underived comparison, and the forward composition isomorphism. Apply mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso_hom_app_factorsh and mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso_hom_app_factorsh, then cancel the composition isomorphism with its inverse. This gives the hypothesis htheta of Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac.

Use Functor.rightDerived_ext for Rf_* followed by exact restriction. Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac computes the mate of the derived inverse-image square after the right-derived unit, using the factorization from the preceding step. Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac gives the same expression for the canonical right-derived comparison; its auxiliary homotopy composition isomorphisms are identities. The underived mate identity from step 1 therefore identifies the derived mate with derivedLowerStarRestrictScalarsMap, hence with the hom of derivedLowerStarRestrictScalarsIso.

Identify derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunctionPlus with Adjunction.derivedPlus using Adjunction.derivedAdjunctionPlus_eq_derivedPlus. Apply Mathlib unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit to the derived inverse-image square and substitute the mate identity from step 3. Expand the source and target coefficient isomorphisms. For the unit postcompose with the inverse direct-image comparison; for the counit precompose with its inverse mapped by inverse image. Isomorphism cancellation gives precisely the two unchanged displayed identities.
